findings.title: Cleanup targets the literal alias instead of the created provider
findings.body: Each created identity provider is registered for cleanup using `identityProviders().get("alias")`, but the providers created in this loop have aliases `idp-alias-0` through `idp-alias-19`. The cleanup callback therefore removes a provider named `alias` rather than the providers created by the test; the same mistake occurs for the provider added at line 425. These providers remain in the test realm after the test and can pollute later tests or make suite results order-dependent. Register cleanup using each provider's actual alias.
